Ivy: FYI I ran a quick bring-up for draft-orion-6b with two-path handoff (opportunistic speculative candidate then rerank). Short-run perf: ~2.1x tokens/s on chat samples.
Diego: good. Any immediate regressions?
Ivy: small context-drift on multi-turn QA after ~120 tokens. Examples saved to /s3/orion/spec-drift/exp1.jsonl.
Priya: what quant config?
Ivy: PTQ8, no QAT. Decode: handoff_mode:opportunistic,handoff_depth:2,reranker:logprob_norm,score_margin:0.25,prefetch:48.
Diego: can you paste the exact command?
Ivy: `run_onboard --model draft-orion-6b --quant ptq8 --policy handoff:opportunistic,depth=2,margin=0.25 --batch 12 --max-toks 1024 --kv-warmup`
Priya: we should test: (1) handoff_depth {1,2,3}, (2) score_margin {0.1,0.25,0.4}, (3) kv_warmup={on,off}. Also include a pure non-handoff baseline.
Ivy: agreed. Ops: can you pin pool 'onboard-small' for the grid? Last time autoscale jitter skewed p95.
ops-bot: pool pinned for job group onboard-orion-exp-20260322. Resource note: prefetch 48 uses ~9GB per replica.
Diego: for eval, track per-turn divergence position distribution, human factuality (150 samples), ROUGE-L on summarization, and a small code-compile check for code tasks. Also log fallback-rate and reranker top-3 deltas.
Priya: acceptance criteria proposal: ROUGE-L delta <= 0.5 and factuality drop <= 0.7 points. If drift position median < 200 tokens we can accept; if >200 then block.
Ivy: preliminary: fallback rate ~4.2% (we only fallback when reranker margin < threshold). Drift median ~130 tokens. Hallucination delta ~0.9% absolute (slightly above target).
Diego: sounds borderline. Try enabling KV_WARMUP aggressive and lowering prefetch to 32 to reduce divergence. Also run QAT6 sweep since quant may affect score calibration.
Priya: also let's capture step-wise candidate entropy and the reranker score distribution; hypothesis: higher entropy correlates with divergence.
Ivy: queued ablation jobs; I'll upload metrics + failed examples to the dashboard and tag you.
eval-bot: human-eval batch scheduled (id: he-orion-20260322-1) 150 samples queued. Results ETA ~8h.
Ivy: will reconvene after human eval. If regression holds we'll tighten score_margin and default to depth=1 for hosted catalog.
Diego: thanks. Small docs note: add a short runbook about spotting KV-drift vs genuine model degradation (check candidate divergence + kv-timesteps).
